about_the_game:
Blizzy has always craved adventure—the more dangerous, the better. Becoming a hero and saving the kingdom? That's the stuff of dreams. But a trip to Hell? Now that's a real opportunity to stretch his legs and prove his mettle. An ancient evil trying to break free? Child's play! The young and fearless Blizzy can handle anything!

Your journey will take you through countless locations and twisted worlds.

Your guide through Hell will be Molek, a tiny imp whose greatest joys in life are candy and children. If you're lucky enough to become one of his favorites, you'll get more than just cruel jokes—you might even get some genuinely helpful advice. After all, watching a child sow chaos is the most entertaining pastime Hell has to offer.

Meanwhile, in The Other Place, you'll take control of Furry—a grumpy but brave forest warden who always comes through when a friend is in trouble.

Creepy Tale throws a variety of mechanics your way: puzzles, platforming, stealth, arcade mini-games, and of course—plenty of action!

Snow Child, the fifth installment in the Creepy Tale saga, brings the epic story to a close—piecing together every last sliver of the chilling puzzle. While deeply tied to the previous chapters, the game stands on its own as a complete, self-contained tale.

  • A rich, story-driven adventure full of quirky characters and unexpected twists.

  • Unique hand-drawn 2D art with frame-by-frame animation.

  • Stealth segments and tightly wound, dynamic scenes.

  • A variety of puzzles and arcade-style mini-games.

  • An original soundtrack and immersive sound design.

  • Full professional voice acting in both English and Russian .

short_description: A volatile cocktail of action and puzzles, spiced with pitch-black humor and a deliciously sinister atmosphere. Journey into Hell alongside a brave boy named Blizzy and defeat Evil itself. Save the world and become a hero. But at what cost?
supported_languages:
English*, Russian*, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Latin America, Simplified Chinese, Turkish, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, French
*languages with full audio support
